title_en: Be careful on the Betong-Yala road.
summary_en: YALA (THAILAND): Malaysian tourists are warned to be on guard when crossing the Betong-Yala Road as Thai security forces expanded a siege to search forest areas at the foot of Mount Saji in Thanto District here, trying to hunt down separatist members who fled after an attack by military troops.
